about: CAGE frame registry: the fixed conventions of the project. Axis definitions, axis-change matrices, angle bins, corner orders, encodings and class lists live here and nowhere else; cage/geometry/frames.py loads this file and every other module imports from there. Per-sample matrices (K, R_gravity, t_cam2) are data and live in each sample's meta.json. tests/test_frames.py checks every entry. Units: meters and radians unless a key ends in _deg.

directions.about: Shared vocabulary for axis meanings, written as unit vectors in the OpenCV camera frame. 'front' is the object-relative name for 'forward': an object frame is described as if the object faced the camera's forward direction.

opencv_camera.used_by: CAGE camera frame C, MoGe, KITTI rectified cameras, KITTI depth maps

upright.used_by: CAGE upright frame U: same axis names as C after rotation by R_gravity, so y is along gravity

total3d_camera.used_by: Total3D 'toward-up-right' camera axes; the Total3D world frame W uses the same order

open3d_display.used_by: Open3D viewer convention (OpenGL): y up, camera looks along -z

box_local.used_by: CAGE box frame: x = length (front), y = height (down), z = width; this is what R_y(heading) rotates

pix3d_model.used_by: Pix3D model frame as Total3D places it: model z runs along the box's length axis. Whether that is the object's physical front is confirmed by eye in task D5.3

axis_changes.about: Each matrix A maps coordinates in 'from' to coordinates in 'to': p_to = A @ p_from. The test derives A from the two frames' axis names and compares.

T.note: Also maps opencv_camera to total3d_camera, and Total3D world W to upright U

F_open3d.note: Display only; never applied to saved data

VELO_TO_CAM_IDEAL.note: Ideal axis permutation. The real rotation is Tr_velo_to_cam[:, :3], within about 1 degree of this

MODEL_TO_BOX.note: Equal to T. Placement: p_U = c + R_y(heading) @ diag(l/2, h/2, w/2) @ MODEL_TO_BOX @ n

M_mirror.note: Horizontal flip. Points p -> M p; rotations R -> M R M; heading h -> pi - h; principal point cx -> W - 1 - cx; 2D box x1' = W - 1 - x2, x2' = W - 1 - x1

rotation_conventions.R_y: [[cos a, 0, sin a], [0, 1, 0], [-sin a, 0, cos a]]; box length axis = R_y(h) @ [1, 0, 0] = (cos h, 0, -sin h)
rotation_conventions.frustum_rotation: p_frustum = R_y(-phi) @ p, phi = atan2(r_x, r_z) for the ray r through the 2D box center
rotation_conventions.total3d_cam_R: R_from_yaw_pitch_roll(0, pitch, roll) = R_z(pitch) @ R_x(roll); negative pitch looks down
rotation_conventions.R_gravity_from_total3d: R_gravity = T @ cam_R @ T = R_x(pitch) @ R_z(roll)

box_corners.about: Sign of each corner along (x, y, z) of the box's own frame.

cage_order.note: Frustum PointNets order; y points down, so corners 0-3 are the bottom face. The KITTI devkit uses the same order.

total3d_order.axes_scale: (coeffs[0], coeffs[1], coeffs[2]) along basis rows b0 (side), b1 (up), b2 (front)

classes.about: kitti and sunrgbd are the classes CAGE trains and evaluates on. nyu40 is indexed by Total3D's size_cls. pix3d is indexed by Total3D's class_id. kins_to_kitti maps KINS category names to KITTI label types; 'rider' is absent on purpose (KITTI has no such class).

kitti_2011_09_26.about: Published calibration of KITTI raw drive 2011_09_26; numbers checked numerically in the Atlas and the Handbook.

sunrgbd_floor_point.about: SUN RGB-D-style intrinsics; a floor pixel 1.48 m below a camera pitched 25 degrees down (Total3D pitch -25).

kitti_flip_offset.about: Mirroring a KITTI image without mirroring cx shifts every projected label by W - 1 - 2 cx pixels.
